newsitem.title: USA: Bando McGlocklin Capital Q2 net down after charge.
newsitem.headline: Bando McGlocklin Capital Q2 net down after charge.

text.p: Bando McGlocklin Capital Corp said Wednesday a charge related to its restructuring as a real estate investment trust in December significantly lowered earnings in the second quarter.
The company said net income in the period ended December 31 totaled $477,737, or $0.12 a share, compared to $817,755, or $0.21 a share, in the corresponding quarter one year ago.
Excluding a nonrecurring charge of $423,469, net income was $871,206, or $0.24 a share, the company said.
Bando McGlocklin provides financial services to small business.
